description: Fetch a cosmetic ingredient page from INKEEDecoder (formerly INCIDecoder): what it does, INKEEDecoder's rating, irritancy and comedogenicity, and optional CosIng identifiers, long-form writeup, and references. Accepts a slug, an /ingredients/ path, or an inkeedecoder.com or incidecoder.com URL. The long writeup is off by default. Read-only.

cosing.description: Include CosIng data: CAS number, EC number, IUPAC name, and official functions. Default false.

details.description: Include the long-form writeup. Default false — it is several thousand characters per ingredient, so ask for it only when the answer needs the detail.

functions.description: Include what the ingredient does, as /ingredient-functions/ links. Default true.

id.description: Ingredient slug, site path (/ingredients/...), or ingredient URL on inkeedecoder.com or incidecoder.com. The slug is the last segment of the page URL. Get one from inkeedecoder_search or a product's ingredient list.

image.description: Include the ingredient's image URL. Default true.

proof.description: Include the reference list cited by the writeup. Default false.

safety.description: Include irritancy and comedogenicity ratings. Default true.

name: inkeedecoder_get_ingredient

name.description: Display name as shown on the site.

slug.description: Stable key; pass it back as the `id` of a lookup tool.

ourTake.description: INKEEDecoder's editorial rating, or null if none is shown.

title: Get an ingredient
